name: clock-quorum-window
user: Reliability engineer comparing captured clock-offset uncertainty estimates.
pain: Find every closed offset interval supported by a required count and expose disjoint or point-only agreement.
smallest_capability: Exact integer interval sweep for k-coverage with separate point/interior support counts and merged quorum windows.
acceptance: Closed shared endpoints count, including zero-width intervals.
Unique source IDs, bounded count, valid intervals and quorum are mandatory.
demand: Inferred from clock synchronization workflows; adjacent NTP/Roughtime/Time-Card tools are broader alternatives.
distinctness: DNS quorum compares serial equality; this tool solves geometric uncertainty overlap.
limits: Not NTP/PTP implementation, authenticated time, clock correction or proof that independent sources are trustworthy.
publication: Website publication in progress; remote CI not yet verified
